name: Arm
overview: The biblical concept of the 'arm' symbolizes God's powerful and active intervention on behalf of His people, as demonstrated in His deliverance of Israel from Egypt. Scripture repeatedly portrays God's mighty hand and stretched-out arm as instruments of redemption, judgment, and protection, emphasizing His sovereign strength and faithfulness. This figurative use highlights God's ability to perform wonders, bring about victory over enemies, and secure His covenant promises through decisive and visible acts of power.
